name: M3_CRS025MI_GetItemGroup
description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific item group based on its identifier. The operation returns the item group code, long description, short name, references to seasonal and trend curves, and catch weight tolerance settings. Item groups are often used as selection and sorting criteria in forecasting and other processes, so this read operation lets you inspect how a group is configured before it is used elsewhere in M3. Only one item group is returned, matching the supplied identifier exactly.

inputParameters.name: ITGR
inputParameters.description: Identifier of the item group to retrieve.

outputParameters.name: TX40
outputParameters.description: Full description of the item group.

outputParameters.name: TX15
outputParameters.description: Short name of the item group, typically used in lists and overviews.

outputParameters.name: SECU
outputParameters.description: Seasonal curve that defines how demand for items in this group is distributed over the year.

outputParameters.name: TECU
outputParameters.description: Trend curve that defines how demand for items in this group changes over time.

outputParameters.name: TCWP
outputParameters.description: Maximum allowed deviation from expected weight for catch weight items in this group, expressed as a percentage.

outputParameters.name: TCWQ
outputParameters.description: Maximum allowed deviation from expected average weight for catch weight items in this group, expressed in weight units.
